basis: Owner instruction 2026-09-30 (Nitin Rajput): "do everything as recommended". Built from the Stage B inventory of the April 2026 production dump (Moodle 4.1.2 upgraded to 4.5.10 and 5.1.3 on a local rehearsal copy with the Sentientia plugins installed): 520 role grants, all at system context, on capabilities of 32 plugins that are not on disk (administrator 214, manager 110, trainer 79, editingteacher 39, employee 21, user 19, teacher 16, guest 11, coursecreator 10, frontpage 1); 421 ALLOW, 71 PREVENT, 28 PROHIBIT. Re-run the inventory on the real live backup at the Stage B rehearsal and re-sign if it differs. Decisions: (1) every missing plugin is declined by component (the 32 the inventory shows, plus local_myteam, one of the 22 BizLMS local plugins that holds no grant in this dump), which covers only its capabilities that have no Sentientia equivalent; (2) the ten mapped capabilities are decided per role: the manager-archetype holds are already carried by the Sentientia archetypes, local/costcenter:manage and :manage_multiorganizations are withheld by the script (ADR-031), local/costcenter:manage_ownorganization and :manage_owndepartments are declined by name for manager and administrator (ADR-031), local/classroom:manageclassroom is granted to the trainer role, and the one trainer PREVENT on local/users:edit is declined by name.

grants.reason: BizLMS trainers manage classrooms on production today (CLAUDE.md: never break current production behaviour), and local/sentientia_classroom:manage reaches only the manager archetype, so without this grant trainers lose classroom management when the BizLMS code goes. Their attendance stays limited to their own sessions because the attendance rule keys on local/sentientia_classroom:update (merged 2026-09-30).
